AJAY KUMAR CHAUDHARI

Mobile: +91-7827536284 E-mailID: ajaymit007@yahoo.com | Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/in/ajaykchaudhari | Location: Pune

SUMMARY

Product Owner with 13+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale product strategy, digital transformation, and regulatory initiatives across Payments, Wholesale Banking, and Retail Banking domains. Proven expertise in delivering complex payment solutions including Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire Transfers, and SWIFT MT/MX Messaging, ISO 20022 Migration, Clearing & Settlement, and Real-Time Payment ecosystems.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology, 2006-2010, from Uttar Pradesh Technical University, UP

CORE SKILLS

 Key Skills - Product Ownership & Product Strategy | SAFe Agile | Scrum | Product Roadmap | Program Increment (PI) Planning | Business Analysis | Requirement Management | Epic, User Story Creation & Acceptance Criteria | Product Backlog and Refinement | Product Demo | Stakeholder and Executive Management | Cross-Functional Team Leadership

 Domain Expertise - Wholesale Banking | Retail Banking | Payments - Cross-Border Payments, Real-Time

Payments (RTP), ACH & Wire Payments | ISO 20022 Migration & Transformation - SWIFT MT/MX Messaging | Clearing & Settlement Processes | Fintech

 Delivery & Transformation - End to End Product Delivery | UAT Coordination and Sign-off | Change Management | Workflow Automation | Data Analysis and Reporting | KPI & Performance Metrics

 Tools, Technology & Products - JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | MS Office Suite | Generative AI | Agentic AI |

API Integration | SQL and Database | ERP | CRM | FINNONE | VMS | ODYSSEY | RET

CORE COMPETENCY

 Extensive experience in defining product roadmaps, managing end-to-end product lifecycles, and driving

large-scale transformation programs aligned with business goal and objectives.

 Skilled in translating complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable solutions while collaborating

with cross-functional stakeholders, technology teams, compliance, operations, and executive leadership.

 Develop deep understanding of business needs by market trends, data analysis and process mapping.

 Strong knowledge of SWIFT ISO 20022 standards, payment message transformation, interoperability

between MT and MX formats, and payment processing workflows across global banking networks.

 Demonstrated success in leading Regulatory Reporting and Compliance applications, including Regulatory Event Tracking (RET) platforms, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements, governance frameworks, audit controls, and risk management standards.

 Experienced in SAFe Agile Product Management, backlog refinement, roadmap planning, requirements management, stakeholder engagement, UAT oversight, and delivery of high-impact banking products that enhance operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, customer experience, and business value across global financial institutions.

ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE

Virtusa Consulting Service Private Limited | Pune 1. Client – CITI Bank | Product Owner | (October 2025 to Till Now)

October2021-Present

Key Roles:  Responsible for CITI Global Regulatory Event Tracking product ownership and strategy including defining

product vision, roadmap and strategic objectives.

 Actively participated in PI planning activities and all scrum ceremonies.  Facilitating requirement workshops, peer discussion and gathering detailed requirements from multiple

stakeholders.

 Translating regulatory requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.  Generative AI and Agentic AI Use Case Identification for RET Product.  Responsible for backlog refinements and prioritization.  Act as primary bridge between business stakeholders, development and delivery team.  Collaborate closely with engineering team to remove critical blockers, and ensure timely delivery of features.  Supporting UAT to ensure successful feature delivery.  Coordinate with other POs, Scrum Masters, and the Release Train Engineer (RTE) across the Agile Release

Train (ART) to manage cross team dependencies mitigate the risks.  Document and maintain product artifacts like Steer-co, RAID log etc.  Tracking production issues and coordinating with support team for issue resolution.  Tracking KPIs and accomplishments and delivery milestones.

2. Client – HSBC | Agile Business Analyst | (October 2021 to Sept 2025)

Project: US Transtar Migration- (Cross border payments, ACH, Wire), CT Account Automation, Repack

Reporting, ISO-20022 SWIFT Migration

Key Roles:  Facilitating requirements workshops and preparing functional requirements documents.  Working closely with product, and business stakeholders to ensure the project deliverables.  Gathered requirements and creating user stories, use case, flow chart, & mockups.  Performing functional testing and facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business user.  Facilitating end user training & centralized user management activity and master data management.  Performing gaps analysis and devising a road map for enhancing applications & ensuring a smooth

implementation.

 Conducted walkthroughs, wrote test cases, and supported SIT/UAT execution.  Responsible for daily production support activity.

Key Deliverables:  Replaced old legacy system with existing product that has been enhanced with more business oriented

features that meets customer, regulatory & compliance bodies’ expectations, and accurate data migration.

 Delivered SWIFT solutions (MT103, MT202, and MT564) and Non-Payment corporate actions MX messages (Seev.001/002/006/007/008/045/046) in HK, UK, US and SG; aligned with ISO 20022 standards.

 Implemented SWIFT Payment (MT103, MT202, and MT564) and cash account automation through

HUB-Hadoop integration with odyssey.

CMS IT Service Private Limited | Mumbai 1. Client – ICICI HFC | Business Analyst | (October 2021 to July 2021)

October2018–July2021

Key Roles:  Led requirements workshops, translating complex business needs into functional specifications for critical banking projects like Loan Origination & Servicing, Customer On boarding, Vendor Management System.

 Facilitating requirements workshops and preparing business requirements documents.  Working closely with technology and business stakeholders to ensure the project deliverables.  Responsible for creating Use Stories and Use Cases, Sequence Flow, and DFDs.  Performing functional testing and facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business user.  Facilitating end user training & centralized user management activity and master data management.  Performing gaps analysis and devising a road map for enhancing applications & ensuring a smooth

implementation.

 Responsible for production support activity and deployments.  Successfully delivered digital solutions resulting in measurable cost savings and improved process

transparency.

Key Deliverables:  Delivered HFC Mobility app that acquires more than one thousand customers in first quarter and smooth

eligibility checks, approvals and loan disbursements.

 Delivered HFC Vendor management system that on boarded 5000+ sales & channel partners and managed

their sales, invoice and domestic payment solutions including NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, and UPI, collaborating with

cross-functional teams to define end-to-end payment processing .

 Maintained master data mapping for various application like APS / Finnone / VMS / FMCANVAS / CRMnext.  Hands-on experience working on different rule engines and process automation tools and techniques.

Destar Infotech Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst  Designed and implemented change management strategies that improve adoption rates and delivered the

April2018–July2018

enhance version of CRM application to various clients.

PG Advisory Services (P) Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst  Conducted in-depth business research, process mapping, and gap analysis to support program objectives.

January2017–November2017

Applied design thinking methodologies to define innovative solutions addressing customer and business needs.

 Led requirement lifecycle management ensuring complete traceability and alignment to business goals.

ITAakash Strategic Software (P) Limited | Mumbai Business Analyst  Led implementation planning and execution to ensure smooth implementation, service quality and risk

June2014–January2017



mitigation. Implemented ERP and CRM solution for multiple clients and post implementation support.

Pinga Solutions (P) Limited | Noida Functional Consultant  Delivered real estate CRM solution for multiple clients and supported post implementation issues.

December2010–May2013
